_status: NEEDS CLINICAL SIGN-OFF. These are site-configurable defaults, not SATS. Every value carries its source or says it has none.
facility: Synthetic district hospital outpatient department (demo only)

GREEN.cite: Uwamahoro et al., Afr J Emerg Med 2020 (CHUK modified SATS): green patients reassessed hourly

YELLOW.cite: LOCAL DEFAULT, no published source: half the SATS yellow target time

ORANGE.cite: SATS-2012 Table 3: orange target time < 10 mins; a waiting orange patient past 10 min is already a breach

RED.cite: SATS-2012 Table 3: red is immediate; a red patient should not be in the waiting queue

spo2_red_below.cite: LOCAL POLICY: SATS-2012 lists 'central cyanosis or SpO2 less than 92%' as a paediatric emergency sign (p.10) and tells the adult triage provider to 'check SpO2 and hand over to SHCP to give O2' when RR scores; this policy applies the paediatric threshold to adults

tews_rise_watch.cite: LOCAL DEFAULT, no published source: a rise of 2+ TEWS points from the patient's triage baseline raises a WATCH flag even if the colour has not changed

single_parameter_3.cite: Adapted from RCP NEWS2 (2017): a score of 3 in any single parameter prompts urgent review. Applied here to TEWS parameters as a WATCH flag

referral.cite: LOCAL DEFAULT: draft (never send) a referral for any patient computed RED at a facility without resus capacity

pain_score_bands.cite: LOCAL DEFAULT: SATS-2012 lists 'severe pain' (very urgent) and 'moderate pain' (urgent) and gives example pain scales (Appendix B) but no 0-10 cut-offs. When a note gives a numeric score N/10, the sign is set from the number: 8-10 severe, 5-7 moderate, 0-4 no pain sign.
